**Core.** Work through it, with the exercises.

## Planned topics

- Running one command over SSH (`ssh host command`); the "host key changed" warning
- SSH and SSH keys; `~/.ssh/config`; jump hosts (`ProxyJump`)
- Connection sharing (`ControlMaster`) so one sign-in serves many connections
- tmux / screen so work survives a dropped connection
- Moving data: `scp`, `rsync`, Globus, through the site's data transfer node (DTN), not the login node
- Checksums to confirm a transfer
- Moving the project to the cluster: copy files, reinstall the environment, recreate links
